question: Which country became a full member of BRICS in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Indonesia__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Expansion of BRICS took place in 2024 with Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, and the UAE becoming full members of BRICS from 1 January 2024.
 
• In January 2025,** Indonesia** joined the BRICS as a full member.
 
• Also,Belarus, Bolivia, Kazakhstan, Cuba, Malaysia, Nigeria, Thailand, Uganda, and Uzbekistan were inducted as partner countries of the BRICS.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **BRICS Overview:**

 
 
• The acronym **BRICS** stands for **Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa**, representing major emerging economies.
 
• BRICS was initially formed in **2006** as BRIC, with South Africa joining later in **2010**.
 
• These countries collectively account for over **40% of the global population** and approximately **25% of the global GDP**.
 
 
 
• **Egypt's Economic Strengths:**
 
 
• Egypt has a **strategic location**, connecting Africa, the Middle East, and Europe, and controls the **Suez Canal**, a vital trade route for global shipping.
 
• It is one of Africa's largest economies, with a GDP of **$477 billion** (as of 2023).
 
• Key sectors include **energy** (especially natural gas), **agriculture**, and **tourism**.
 
 
 
• **BRICS Expansion:**
 
 
• The decision to expand BRICS was driven by the need to include more emerging economies and strengthen its role in global governance.
 
• Other countries that joined in the 2023 expansion include **Iran**, the **UAE**, and **Ethiopia**.
 
• **Saudi Arabia** was invited in 2024 but has yet to formalise its full membership status.
 
• **Argentina** was also invited but officially declined.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Suez Canal:**

 
 
• The **Suez Canal** is one of the world's most important trade routes, connecting the Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea.
 
• Approximately **12% of global trade** passes through the canal annually, making Egypt a critical player in international trade logistics.
 
 
 
• **BRICS Bank:**
 
 
• The **New Development Bank (NDB)**, established by BRICS, provides funding for infrastructure and sustainable development projects in member countries.
 
• Egypt is expected to benefit from NDB financing for **energy**, **transport**, and **water infrastructure** projects.
